release_date.note: arXiv v1 date of the Flan Collection paper.

availability.note: HTTP 200 on the repo page. Only the repo page was checked, not each file. Third-party HF mirror Muennighoff/flan also exists.

content.value: Orca 2 paper: 'the FLAN-v2 Collection [33], which consists of five sub-collections, namely, CoT, NiV2, T0, Flan 2021 and Dialogue'; Orca 2 was first finetuned 'on the train split of FLAN-v2 dataset for one epoch'. Reference [33] in that paper is Longpre et al., 'The Flan Collection: Designing Data and Methods for Effective Instruction Tuning' (arXiv 2301.13688).
content.note: Recorded because orca-2-7b trained on it directly (Orca 2 paper section 4.2). Human-written task data, so no model parents recorded; the Flan Collection paper itself was not read in full.

record_history.change: created from primary sources (needed by orca-2-7b trained_on edge; panel ruling 2/3 dataset routing)
